name: Tank Volume Calculator
description: Calculate the volume of a cylindrical tank from diameter and height.

seo.title: Tank Volume Calculator - Cylinder Volume
seo.description: Calculate tank volume — Cylindrical, rectangular & spherical vessels with multiple unit options

formula.explanation: Cylinder volume V = πr²h where r = diameter/2. d and h in meters. ×1000 converts m³ to liters.

content.introduction: Calculate the volume of a vertical or horizontal cylindrical tank. This is used for storage tank sizing, capacity planning, and inventory calculations.

example.description: A 3m diameter × 6m tall cylindrical tank holds approximately 42,412 liters (42.4 m³).

faq.a: No, this calculates straight cylinder volume only. For dished ends, add approximately 10-15% additional volume depending on head type.

faq.q: How do I calculate horizontal tank partial volume?
faq.a: Partial volume (with liquid level) requires the circular segment formula, which is a separate calculation.
